title: Pocket Emergency Breeze
body:
For when you NEED air and you need it NOW. Fits in your pocket. Battery powered. Has saved countless lives (citation needed).

Features:
- Battery powered
- Foldable design
- Lanyard included
- 3 colors available
- Great for concerts
summary: For when you NEED air and you need it NOW. Fits in your pocket. Battery powered.

comments.content: The CFM ratings are accurate. I measured. This is the only fan site you need.
